purpose: Teach: ジャーナル/出社/引き受ける/役立っ/開場/引き締め/スワップ/手動

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、業界ジャーナル、海外のものにも、目を、通せ、視野、広く、持つこと、本当に、大切だぞ。
lines.en: Ren — read industry journals from overseas too. Keeping your perspective wide is really essential.
lines.style: Measured, paternal opening. Slight weight on the core advice — 'wide perspective'. Not lecturing, but confident in the truth he's sharing. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。インターン、毎週、定時に、出社、努めております、社会人として、自覚、持っています。
lines.en: Yes. I make sure to arrive on time every week as an intern, and I'm working to carry that sense of responsibility as a professional.
lines.style: Formal, attentive deference. Each phrase lands with care — he's addressing the senior directly. Earnest without being effusive. A little careful not to oversell himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 責任、自分から、引き受ける姿勢、社会人として、成長するために、必要だ、覚えておけ。
lines.en: Taking responsibility without being asked — that's the mindset you need to grow as a professional. Remember that.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. A clear beat on the core principle. He's settling something important into Ren's mind, not just talking at him. Slightly slower pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩の論文、研究、本当に、役立っております、参考、させていただいて、感謝です、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. Your papers and research have been genuinely helpful — I'm grateful for the chance to learn from them.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity underneath the politeness. Not flowery. He means it. Slight hesitation before 'grateful' — checking himself that it's okay to say it aloud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学会発表、開場前から、緊張するもんだ、君も、慣れていけ、経験、積めば、楽になる。
lines.en: Conference presentations always make you nervous before they start. You'll get used to it as you gain experience — it gets easier.
lines.style: Reassuring, matter-of-fact. He's speaking from experience. Light, almost conversational rhythm. Not dismissing the nervousness, just normalizing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の引き締め、研究室、全員で、心がけております、無駄な、出費、避けるよう。
lines.en: Yes. Our whole lab is being careful about the research budget — we're working to avoid unnecessary expenses.
lines.style: Alert, responsible tone. He's demonstrating he grasps the practical side. Professional clarity without stiffness. A note of conscientious care threaded through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学術界、留学生スワップ、活発化しているな、君も、海外、行ってみる気、あるか?
lines.en: The academic world is seeing more of these international student exchanges. Are you interested in going abroad yourself?
lines.style: Curious, opening-up shift. Less directive now — he's asking something genuine. Warmer pace. Inviting Ren to think beyond the immediate.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験は、最初は、手動から、始めるのが、基本ですよね、基礎を、しっかり、身につけたいです。
lines.en: Yes. In experiments, the foundation is to start with the manual work first — I want to build a solid base in the basics.
lines.style: Thoughtful and grounded. He's circling back to fundamentals, which is his nature. Quiet determination. Not rushed, deliberately paced to show he's thought this through.
